versions.changelog:
direct-flights v3.2.1

- Updated documentation files: README.md, SKILL.md, and references/*.md
- No functional or CLI command changes; this release focuses on improved instructions and clarity
- Enhanced parameter collection and output formatting guides for easier skill usage
- Clarified activation triggers and fallback handling in playbook references

direct-flights v3.2.0

- Critical new execution rules requiring all data to be sourced from the flyai CLI; responses from training data are strictly forbidden.
- Added strict validation: every output must include a [Book](detailUrl) link from CLI data.
- Expanded command parameter documentation and clarified supported sort options.
- Output templates and self-check steps updated to ensure only real-time, bookable flight data.
- Strict multi-step core workflow: environment check, parameter collection, CLI execution, JSON-to-Markdown formatting, and CLI-link validation.
- Enhanced coverage of user triggers for direct/non-stop flight search in both English and Chinese.
